highlights: Earn up to 10% cashback for spends above S$1,500 on selected Bonus Merchants. 0.5% unlimited cashback on all other spends.
pros: Earn up to 10% cashback for spends above S$1,500 on selected merchants.
pros: Earn up to 8% cashback for spends above S$800 on selected merchants.
pros: Enjoy 0.5% cashback for all base spends with no monthly cashback cap.
pros: Enjoy peace of mind when your flight is delayed with Visa SmartDelay™, which offers complimentary access to over 1,700 airport lounges and travel experiences.
pros: Interest-free instalments with SC Easy Pay.
pros: First-year annual fee waived for new cardholders (S$91 excl. GST thereafter)
cons: Cashback awarded in the form of 360° Rewards Points.
pros: Flexible redemption options for miles, cashback or shopping vouchers
pros: Interest-free Installments with SC Easy Pay

extra.description: The Standard Chartered Smart Credit Card is a great option to have if you frequent fast-food outlets, pay for digital subscriptions or commute regularly on bus or MRT. Cashback is earned in the form of Rewards Points, which you can redeem for 6% cashback. With zero annual fees and no minimum spend requirements, it is the perfect card to have for everyday spending.
